text:
maya: quick pass — noticed odd behavior in Playground streaming + token counter when regen or quick-insert from prompt library. token meter jumps to final then vanishes when you hit Stop/Regenerate. anyone seen this? alex: which view? compact rail or full composer? maya: compact convo rail on prod (playground compact). repro with long completions that stream in chunks, esp. code blocks. also happens if you insert a saved prompt while streaming. rcook: saw a report — seems like we reset the counter on stream end but we also set it to final in-flight. UI race between stream updates and finalize flow. jenna: accessibility check: if screen reader gets a bunch of rapid updates that's noisy. we should debounce aria-live updates. maya: agree. proposal: keep two displays — live partial counter (small, muted) and final counter (bold) after finished. live counter should be aria-hidden and final should be announced on completion only. alex: example markup idea: ```
~324
Completed: 324 / 2048
``` rcook: thumbs-up. also add a 500ms throttle on visual live updates so the UI doesn't reflow on every chunk. that should reduce jank. sam: keyboard/intent question — if user hits a prompt library quick-insert while streaming, should we cancel stream, queue insert, or append to the prompt buffer? current behavior cancels and drops partial output. maya: that's the problem. dropping partial output is bad. UX options: - queue insert and show a small toast "Prompt queued — will apply after you stop or regenerate" - do a soft-insert into the input composer buffer without interrupting stream jenna: I prefer queue + toast. less surprising for end users. copy suggestion: "Queued prompt to insert — stop to apply". short enough. rcook: low-effort implementation: don't interrupt stream, stash the insertion server-side and expose a boolean flag. on next stop/regenerate we merge. quick local UX: ephemeral banner with undo. maya: accessibility nit: stop button label reads just "Stop" — screen reader contextless. change to "Stop streaming response" and include a tooltip with shortcut (Esc). alex: +1 on clearer label. also ensure focus ring persists when action is triggered via keyboard. current focus disappears when stream stops. accessibility-bot: contrast check: token pill color (#7B61FF on #FFFFFF) fails AA small text. consider darker fill or bold text. jenna: I'll update the figma with: - dual-counter mock - stop button copy change - prompt-queue toast copy - keyboard hint (Esc to stop, Ctrl+Enter run). will post link when ready. maya: perfect. I'll add a brief interaction spec for debounce timing (500ms visual, announce final only) and queue behavior. will ping engineering for a spike. rcook: assign spike to me. i'll prototype throttle + queue toggle. thanks all. maya: :thumbsup: cool — will follow up with Figma + interaction note in this thread.
